mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.05% over 3 consecutive months reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate rises above 5.5% and remains elevated for 3 months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 1500 and GDP growth below 19000 for 6 months indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline for 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 265 for 3 months), policy shifts reduce liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 265 for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0 for 3 consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95.0 for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL > 260 for 3 months) erodes real corporate profits, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days due to reduced consumer purchasing power.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 260 for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate above 5.5% and employment decline below 145,000 for 3 months signals labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both UNRATE > 5.5 and PAYEMS < 145000 for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1500 for 3 consecutive months indicates real estate sector contraction, reducing consumer confidence and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST falls below 1500 for 3 months.
